description: The complete India income tax computation for 2026-27, as on the return. Covers: New and old regime, always both, with the better one; Salary: HRA, LTA, perquisites, employer contributions above ₹7.5 lakh, professional tax; House property: self-occupied, let out, deemed let out, loss set-off and carry-forward; Other income incl. 80TTA/80TTB, family pension, winnings at 30%; Capital gains: equity, property (indexation option), debt funds, crypto, exemptions, loss set-off; All Chapter VI-A deductions with their limits; Rebate with marginal relief, surcharge with its caps and marginal relief, cess, TDS and the balance; Presumptive business and professional income (44AD/44ADA); and more. Returns the tax, the balance still to pay or to be refunded after taxes already paid, every option the law offers compared, and each step with its legal reference. All amounts in INR; everything is optional, give only what applies. What is not modelled is listed in the result.
